Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for Enterococcus faecalis (>100,000 CFU/mL), indicating a urinary tract infection. Hematuria and mild proteinuria are present. Glucosuria is noted without ketonuria. Low urine specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of appropriate antibiotic therapy.
